name: Optical Edge Rupture Topography
description: The reaper’s scythe circling the physical boundaries of an object. No matter how painstaking a Photoshop surgeon operates, they can mathematically never synthesize an organic 3D optical lens edge. A fraudster's borders perpetually harbor invisible jagged staircasing, or unnaturally thick manual 'Feather/Anti-Aliasing' blurs deployed in a desperate attempt to bury the dirty splice. This edge-caliper radar stalks every microscopic millimeter of an outline to ruthlessly execute mismatched visual data.
algorithm: Sobel/Canny Outlier Detection & Boundary Thickness Morphology
mechanism: It mercilessly dissects the width and contrast-transition gradient operating exclusively along the jawline, shoulders, or clothing silhouette. Authentic physics mandate that organic optical borders harbor immense micro-diffraction overlap where objects meet the background. Lazy fraudsters wielding the Lasso/Magic Wand tool impart a razor-sharp, blade-like mathematical cut completely devoid of organic depth... The engine merely has to detect the absence of microscopic chromatic aberration along the splice to trigger an execution alarm.
parameters: Geometry Map: Canny/Sobel Gradients, Force: 2nd-Order Mask Differentials, Object: Feather/Spill Inconsistency
accuracy: Extremely Solid (78-86%) - The supreme terminator hunting down any and all cheap digital 'green-screen' splicing or 2D copy-paste forgeries.
source: Digital Optics Forgery Detection Archive (Splice Boundary Inconsistency)
useCase: Operates directly upon the demilitarized zone where two colliding objects meet: Forensically proving whether the pixel inter-lacing is a natural phenomenon of light scattering or synthetic graphical garbage.

references.title: Barni, M. et al. (2010). Forensic analysis of digital images: Spatial contrast and inconsistency.

strengths:
• Completely bypasses human perception traps. It sees physically whether a t-shirt edge interacts with the background via 3D multi-layered diffraction or merely rests as a cheap, mathematically flat 2D sticker.
• Lightning-fast execution speeds solely tracking the ultra-thin 'border rind' and discarding the massive computational weight of the object's interior.
limitations:
• The forensic blade harmlessly flies off the handle if the genuine target was shot with a massive f/1.2 aperture, utterly obliterating the natural physical edges into a bokeh-smear.
• Disarmed if the perpetrator abandons manual splicing for modern AI Generative In-painting, which synthetically hallucinates a continuously smooth fake boundary rather than leaving crude Photoshop staircases.
